descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S09 Custom domain over HTTPS: valid certificate, http redirects

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 The production web app works on its custom domain over HTTPS. (TFA-94704 AC 2; TFA-94704 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere. (UAT OAT-02; UAT 4; TFA-92568 AC 4; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given The production web app on its custom domain (for example app.roundcompanion.com, TFA-94704 How it works 2)

When Open https://<domain>, http://<domain>, and the apex and www variants

Then https:// loads the app with a valid certificate for the exact host, and http:// redirects to https:// without serving the app

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94704 AC 2 'Custom domain with HTTPS works' plus UAT step 1. A certificate error, an expired certificate, or the app served over http:// = Fail.

Where it ran: dev; test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)
